_meta.description: Ari Helper puts every AI model you use in one private app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, and now makes and repairs pictures and films on device. Photo Studio, Film Studio, on-device models, your own keys. $24.99 once.
_title: Ari Helper 7 — Your AI. Your Pictures. Your Films.
a-color-photo-turned.12969e: A color photo turned black and white, then colored again by the model: blue sea, golden rock, wet sand. A strength slider sets how bold the color is.
any-model-you-trust.0cdf50: Any model you trust. Keep it on device for privacy, or send it to a stronger vision model when you need one.
apollo-11-television-nasa.dcdfda: Apollo 11 television — NASA, 1969, shown at twice its size. Grain was removed across frames, then noise: the fine speckle drops by about a third, and the picture keeps its tone.
apple-intelligence-on-device.9be2aa: Apple Intelligence; on-device models you download inside Ari, such as Gemma 4; models on your own network through Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, LiteLLM); and OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok and AWS Bedrock with your own keys. Images come from on-device models, Draw Things, GPT Image, Imagen or Grok Imagine.
ari-helper-7-iphone.aaefe6: Ari Helper 7 · iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch
ari-helper-is-built.f17bb6: Ari Helper is built with multiple layers of privacy and security protections to give you full control over your data:
ari-works-the-same.ea48bb: Ari works the same on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and one purchase covers them all. Conversations and films sync through iCloud. When two of your devices share a Wi-Fi network, a conversation reaches the other one in about a second.
ask-ari-generate-pictures.81db53: Ask Ari, generate pictures, read PDFs and dispatch work from a full Shortcuts catalog.
aws-bedrock-including-govcloud.7d8f75: AWS Bedrock, including GovCloud and FIPS endpoints, for teams with rules to follow.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
bring-your-models-bring.372ea1: Bring your models. Bring your photos.
brush-it-out-paint.09c42b: Brush it out. Paint over what should go; Ari fits the stroke to the object and fills it in.
brush-over-it-watch.2a1039: Brush over it. Watch it go.
can-i-share-conversations.a8722e: Can I share conversations with others?
can-i-tell-whether.15df7c: Can I tell whether a picture came from Ari Helper?
chat-with-apple-intelligence.1846e1: Chat with Apple Intelligence, a model on your own device, your own server, or any cloud provider you have a key for — all in one private app. Point the camera at the world and just ask. And when a picture or a film needs fixing, Ari 7's studios do it on your device.
chat-with-on-device.abc577: Chat with on-device, self-hosted and cloud models
clean-up-any-video.451250: Clean up any video, not just your own.
code-sessions-and-dispatch.d7c182: Code Sessions and Dispatch on the Mac
code-sessions-give-a.7a4a56: Code Sessions give a model tools to read, edit, search, run git and the shell, browse and use MCP servers inside a project folder.
colour-stays-put-a.1a4db5: Colour stays put. A cleaned clip keeps its colours and its rotation.
confirmation-dialogs-before-sending.f86e: Confirmation dialogs — Before sending prompts to external providers, Ari Helper can present confirmation dialogs so you always have a chance to review what's being sent and to which provider before any data leaves your device.
conversations-sync-across-all.2f9544: Conversations sync across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Start a chat on your iPhone and continue it on your iPad or Mac seamlessly. When two of your devices are awake on the same Wi-Fi, Ari also hands the conversation straight across the local network, so it lands in about a second instead of waiting for the next iCloud round trip.
describe-each-shot-and.7e6cf9: Describe each shot and how long it runs. Narration and a still to start from are optional.
describe-it-instead-say.4df21b: Describe it instead. Say what should be in the selection and a generative model paints it in.
dictate-from-the-ask.46979e: Dictate from the Ask Ari complication and watch the answer stream in from your iPhone, spoken if you like.
do-the-photo-and.797e1f: Do the photo and film tools upload my pictures?
does-ari-helper-require.b22f7e: Does Ari Helper require a subscription?
downloaded-once-each-model.0569fc: Downloaded once. Each model downloads the first time you use it. Nothing is uploaded.
draw-things-is-an.79777f: Draw Things is an on-device image generation app. Connect Ari Helper to a Draw Things server to generate images privately on your device or network. View and enjoy generated images in Ari's built-in gallery slideshow.
each-shot-is-rendered.e7164d: Each shot is rendered on its own, with the settings its model needs, and shows a live preview while it works.
earthrise-shrunk-to-320.aa1f50: Earthrise shrunk to 320 pixels, then enlarged four times: on the left the ordinary way, on the right by Ari, with detail added to match.
encrypted-local-sync-when.36cd3d: Encrypted local sync — When a conversation moves directly between your own devices over Wi-Fi, a private conversation crosses the link as exactly the encrypted bytes it is on disk; nothing is decrypted in transit, and the key that opens it never leaves your iCloud keychain. The link itself is TLS, and only devices signed in to your own iCloud account can complete the handshake.
encrypted-private-conversations-sens.fe3: Encrypted Private Conversations — Sensitive chats can be encrypted and locked behind biometric authentication (Face ID or Touch ID). Private conversations are encrypted on device, so even if someone has access to your device they cannot read them without your biometric approval.
every-future-update-no.1a36a4: Every future update — no subscription, no account
everything-below-was-produced.4002b7: Everything below was produced by Ari on pictures that ship with the app. Where a picture had nothing to fix, the flaw was added first, so you can compare the result with the real original. Open "See what each tool does" in Ari to run them yourself.
film-studio-is-laid.2dd49c: Film Studio is laid out like an editing suite. Write a film as a list of shots, render each with the video model you choose, keep the takes that work, and watch the cut come together above the timeline. Films sync through iCloud, so a scene started on the Mac is there on the iPhone.
film-studio-with-a.e3c3ba: Film Studio, with a clean-up pass for any video
for-every-apple-device.800dee: for every Apple device you own, with every update
for-on-device-models.5ee4fb: for on-device models, your own server and every major cloud provider
fortress-mode-limit-ari.cabbef: Fortress Mode. Limit Ari to the providers you trust. Organisations can require it with an MDM profile.
fortress-mode-lock-down.2900b6: Fortress Mode — Lock down the app to only allow connections to secure, vetted model platforms. When enabled, Ari Helper restricts which providers can be used, ensuring your sensitive prompts are only sent to trusted endpoints. IT administrators can also enforce Fortress Mode across an organization via Apple MDM profiles.
grade-in-luma-open.1e2e3b: Grade in Luma. Open the Retouch tab on the photo you are working on.
grain-is-removed-across.a52cf7: Grain is removed across frames. Grain changes from one frame to the next and the picture doesn't, so Ari can tell them apart without guessing.
heal-and-remove-brush.c9183b: Heal and remove. Brush roughly over a leash, a sign or a stranger; Ari fits the stroke to the object and fills the gap.
heavy-sensor-noise-added.dedf9c: Heavy sensor noise added to a clean photograph, then removed without smearing the rail or the clouds.
how-does-ari-helper.306a01: How does Ari Helper protect my privacy and security?
how-does-ari-work.a9ce41: How does Ari work with Luma Editor?
how-does-the-live.951b68: How does the live camera work?
inside-photos-the-same.a0d13b: Inside Photos. The same tools, from the Edit screen of the Photos app.
is-ari-helper-available.e70f87: Is Ari Helper available in the European Union?
is-my-data-private.ac57e0: Is my data private when using local models?
it-reads-what-you.bcd325: It reads what you share. Attach photos, PDFs and source files; Ari reads text and objects in pictures on device, so Spotlight finds a conversation by what was in its images.
keep-looking-turn-it.681a30: Keep looking. Turn it on and Ari follows along as you move, describing what's in front of you.
keep-the-good-takes.772588: Keep the good takes, drop the rest, and play the film from the first shot to the last.
look-at-something-turns.434b73: Look at Something turns the camera into a conversation. Ari sends what you see to the model you've chosen — on device, self-hosted or in the cloud — captions the answer under the picture, and reads it to you.
luma-editor-grades-a.13163f: Luma Editor grades a photograph with real sliders and never makes up content. When something needs to go, Luma sends the photo to Ari's Photo Studio, and Ari sends it back with your grade still applied.
marked-pictures-images-ari.2e9979: Marked pictures. Images Ari generates carry an invisible watermark that survives compression. Check a picture in your browser.
mather-point-grand-canyon.e92d39: Mather Point, Grand Canyon — National Park Service.
most-ai-apps-choose.f087b3: Most AI apps choose the model, keep your conversations and charge by the month. Ari does the opposite. It runs the model you pick — one on your iPhone, one on the Mac under your desk, or one from any provider you have a key for — and keeps what you say on your devices.
no-ari-helper-is.5ac3b6: No. Ari Helper is one purchase that covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, including future updates. Cloud providers you connect with your own API keys bill you directly for what you use.
no-the-restoration-models.7e7645: No. The restoration models download from their public hosts the first time you use them, then run on your device. The only exception is repainting from a description, which uses the provider you pick and follows that provider's privacy policy.
on-device-models-run.0ff0d1: On-device models — Run AI models entirely on your device using Apple's MLX framework. Your prompts and responses never leave your device, giving you complete privacy with zero external dependencies.
one-press-away-start.2a5d62: One press away. Start it from the button beside the microphone, the Lock Screen, Control Center, the Action Button or Siri.
one-purchase-for-iphone.ee7319: One purchase for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No subscription, no account.
one-purchase-in-the.6d3d06: One purchase in the US, for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Prices vary by country.
open-look-at-something.89449e: Open Look at Something from the button beside the microphone, the Lock Screen, Control Center, the Action Button or Siri, point the camera and ask a question out loud or in text. Ari sends the frame to whichever model you've chosen, captions the answer under the picture and can read it to you, then listens for your next question. Turn on Keep looking and it follows along as you move. With an on-device model, nothing leaves your iPhone.
pay-once-bring-your.0f124d: Pay once. Bring your own keys.
photo-studio-and-film.5616b3: Photo Studio and Film Studio, new in Ari 7
photo-studio-in-the.d566e4: Photo Studio, in the app and inside Photos
photo-studio-is-a.f2db97: Photo Studio is a canvas editor with on-device models behind it. Paint over what's wrong and pick a tool, or select nothing and treat the whole photograph. Every step is kept, so going back three edits takes one tap.
photo-studio-removes-objects.253b57: Photo Studio removes objects you brush over, repairs scratches and creases, reduces noise, sharpens slight camera shake, adds color to black-and-white photos and enlarges pictures four times. It can also repaint a selection from a description. Film Studio renders a film shot by shot with the video model you choose, and cleans up any video: de-interlacing, grain and noise removal, sharpening, color, upscaling and extra frames. Face restoration is not included yet — none of the models tested were good enough.
pictures-from-a-sentence.de074d: Pictures from a sentence. Generate images on device, through Draw Things, or with GPT Image, Imagen and Grok Imagine.
point-ask-by-voice.f535e9: point, ask by voice, and hear the answer
point-the-camera-ask.8a70fd: Point the camera. Ask out loud.
private-by-default-on.ef6f93: Private by default. On-device models run on Apple silicon with MLX and need no network. Your prompts don't leave the device.
private-conversations-encrypted-on.a055e: Private conversations. Encrypted on the device and behind Face ID. Their pictures stay out of Spotlight, and they travel between your devices still encrypted.
ready-for-ios-27.ee6eee: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / watchOS 27
remove-something-in-ari.015aec: Remove Something in Ari. Luma hands the untouched photo, at full size, to Photo Studio.
repair-denoise-sharpen-colorize.e426e3: Repair, denoise, sharpen, colorize, upscale. On a selection or the whole photograph, with a strength slider for color.
save-to-luma-editor.bc4552: Save to Luma Editor. You're back in Luma with the object gone and your grade unchanged.
scratches-a-crease-and.82b7a0: Scratches, a crease and dust over a sunset, brushed over and healed from what surrounds each one. On an old scan, Repair damage looks for them itself.
send-heavy-prompts-from.b9fe01: Send heavy prompts from your iPhone to your Mac, and let the Mac decide when to run them.
so-you-can-ask.03251b: So you can ask about a recipe on your wrist, send a long document to Claude from your iPhone, and let the Mac finish the heavy lifting overnight — then point the camera at a plant you can't name, or clean up the photos from the weekend, without anything leaving your hands.
spoken-back-to-you.3bfc4d: Spoken back to you. Replies can be read aloud with a natural voice, and a conversation can be hands-free from start to finish.
start-a-question-with.f0ab06: Start a question with Apple Intelligence, send the follow-up to Claude, and ask a model on your own Mac for a second opinion — in the same thread, with the same attachments.
start-on-your-wrist.796abb: Start on your wrist. Finish at your desk.
talk-don-t-type.0fdebc: Talk, don't type. Ask a question and Ari listens, answers, then listens again, so you can keep going with your hands full.
the-beach-photographs-are.81eb29: The beach photographs are sample pictures from Luma Editor. Mather Point, Grand Canyon (National Park Service), Earthrise (NASA, Apollo 8, 1968) and the Apollo 11 television broadcast (NASA, 1969) are in the public domain. Every result was produced by Ari Helper. Colorizing uses DDColor (Apache 2.0), noise reduction and deblurring use NAFNet (MIT), and damage repair uses LaMa (Apache 2.0).
the-clean-up-menu.b64471: The Clean up menu runs a whole restoration pass on one shot, on the finished cut, or on any video file you open. Ari runs each step in the order that works best.
the-darkroom-matches-the.2a7d99: The darkroom. Matches the look of a photograph you admire and gives it back as adjustments you can keep editing.
the-pictures-and-files.22ac31: The pictures and files in a conversation travel the same way, not just their names—the receiving device asks only for what it's missing, and every file is verified against a hash before it's kept. Anything over 16 MB is deliberately left to iCloud, which resumes and survives a quit. iCloud remains the system of record either way: a device that's asleep, on cellular, or on another network catches up exactly as it always has. If you'd rather everything went through the cloud, the local link can be switched off in Settings → API Settings → Direct Device Link.
the-studio-removes-objects.bb0ca2: The studio. Removes objects, repairs, cleans up and enlarges, on your device.
the-visitor-on-the.9a851c: The visitor on the right was brushed over once; Ari fitted the stroke to them and painted in the canyon behind.
us-prices-as-listed.1ed3da: US prices as listed by each developer in September 2026. They do different things — Private LLM is chat only, Photomator edits photos, Topaz enhances video, Remini restores photos. This shows what each costs, not that they are the same. Cloud models you use with your own keys are billed by their providers.
what-ai-models-can.762d0d: What AI models can I use with Ari Helper?
what-can-photo-studio.1a29c3: What can Photo Studio and Film Studio do?
when-both-apps-are.bf3fe4: When both apps are installed, Luma's Retouch tab offers Remove Something in Ari. Luma sends the untouched photo to Photo Studio; after you remove what you need, Save to Luma Editor returns you to Luma with the object gone and your grade still applied.
whether-you-re-running.ddec8d: Whether you're running models entirely on device, connecting to a self-hosted Ollama instance on your network, or using a cloud provider — Ari Helper gives you the tools to choose the privacy level that's right for each conversation.
write-a-film-one.7c29d5: Write a film one shot at a time.
yes-ari-helper-adds.f988c0: Yes. Ari Helper adds an invisible mark to the pictures it generates, carried by the image itself rather than by metadata that a re-save would strip, and it survives ordinary compression. Check a picture here — it runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
yes-ari-helper-is.0f9dc6: Yes. Ari Helper is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers except mainland China, which has its own rules for apps that generate AI content.
yes-when-using-local.7d1876: Yes! When using local on-device models or Ollama on your network, no data leaves your device or local network. Private mode with biometric lock adds extra security for sensitive conversations.
yes-you-can-share.13d3cb: Yes! You can share conversations as beautiful images or HTML files, perfect for sharing insights, code snippets, or creative content with friends and colleagues.
your-ai-should-work.a97097: Your AI should work for you, not the other way round.
your-own-keys-cloud.d37a4c: Your own keys. Cloud providers are billed to your account at their prices. Ari takes no cut and keeps no copy.
your-own-server-point.986451: Your own server. Point Ari at Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server by entering its address.
